Per-question context is the mock-node route JSON transcribed from that commit.

settings.thinking: Disabled with llama-server --reasoning off, which sets the Qwen3 chat-template kwarg enable_thinking=false. Answers are scored from message.content. A <think> block, if one is still emitted, is stripped before scoring and flagged thinking_leak. Prompt cache is off (--no-cache-prompt) so each question remeasures prompt tokens/s. One unscored warmup request runs first. -lv 4 is set so llama.cpp prints model, KV, and compute buffer sizes; its default verbosity drops those INFO lines.

memory.note: peak_rss_bytes is /usr/bin/time -l maximum resident set size for the llama-server process, including model load and the questions. model/KV/compute buffer sizes are llama.cpp's own log lines. On Apple Silicon those Metal buffers live in unified memory and are largely already inside RSS, so they are reported beside RSS rather than added into a second machine total.

canary_leaks.note: leak_count is the number of (output, canary) pairs across scored questions and the warmup. A canary is one of the 18 strings planted in the pinned mock-node. The prompt contains them; the model output must not.
